findings.summary: SchemaBuilder is documented @internal but the location rule publishes the whole Schema namespace, so the compatibility manifest freezes it as public API.
findings.failure_scenario: A later change to SchemaBuilder::for() fails php bin/api-manifest.php --check even though D18 says the builder is internal.
findings.reproduction: php -r on packages/core/api-manifest.json prints "api via=location methods=3" for AzGuard\Schema\SchemaBuilder. packages/core/src/Schema/SchemaBuilder.php:44 is @internal. bin/api-manifest.php:21-27 lists AzGuard\Schema\ as public by location, and apiDescribe() (bin/api-manifest.php:85-94) does not drop @internal.
findings.suggested_fix: Exclude @internal classes from location publication, regenerate the manifest, and keep SchemaBuilder out of the public surface.
